The '''Dentamma Nebula''' was located in the [[Varada sector/Legends|Varada sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The information presented in ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]'' is set between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Monio]] of the Dentamma Nebula [[Gambling/Legends|bet]] the ownership of the entire [[Unnipar system/Legends|Unnipar system]]<ref name="Planets">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref> of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in a high-stakes [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game. The [[Teltior]] [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Ceezva]], who had bluffed her way into the game, subsequently won the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] from Monio.<ref name="Planets" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dentamma Nebula was first mentioned in the [[1993]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]'', written by [[John Terra]].<ref name="Planets" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the nebula in grid square I-19.<ref name="EAOC" />
